title: Off the Bucket List
meta_description: Seaside Home w/ Rooftop Gulf Views- Off the Bucket List by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Off the Bucket List by Royal Destinations Location: Seaside Address: 45 Wakulla Lane Details: Off the Bucket List is a beautifully renovated luxury cottage located in the heart of iconic Seaside. Thoughtfully restored to preserve its Victorian-inspired charm while introducing sophisticated finishes and modern comforts, this elegant home offers approximately 3,593 square feet of living space and comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with four bedrooms, three full baths, and two half baths. Two spacious living areas, beautifully appointed interiors, and multiple porches provide plenty of room to gather, relax, and experience the distinctive character of Seaside. Ideally located across from Croquet Lawn, Off the Bucket List is approximately a 30-second walk from the Seaside Family Pool, Adult Pool, Fitness Center, and playground. The Seaside Town Center is approximately a five-minute walk away, while the community’s beautiful Gulf beaches are approximately six minutes from the home. Multiple outdoor spaces invite you to enjoy the coastal surroundings, including a covered porch with a daybed and a lookout tower offering expansive views across Seaside with glimpses of the Gulf. With its exceptional location, resort amenities, and beautifully restored interiors, Off the Bucket List offers an unforgettable way to experience Seaside. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 6-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside Town Center: Approximately 5-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (1) Designated Space, Additional Parking Available Throughout Seaside -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Island Seating for 5, Bar Seating for 3 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker -Seaside Community Pool Access* -Seaside Fitness Center Access* -(6) Tennis Courts (Fees Apply) -Croquet Courts -(2) Living Areas -Lookout Tower with Seaside and Gulf Views -Multiple Covered and Open Porches -Covered Porch with Daybed -Wet Bar with Wine Chiller and Ice Maker *Swim and Fitness passes are included with the reservation. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity, Walk-In Closet) -Living Room -Laundry Room -Half Bath -Covered Porch Second Floor: -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Wet Bar -Reading Nook -Half Bath -Covered Porch with Daybed Third Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Clawfoot Tub, Double Vanity, Walk-In Closet) and Sitting Room -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Jack-and-Jill Bath (Walk-In Shower, Separate Vanity) -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Built-In Bunks with Shared Jack-and-Jill Bath (Walk-In Shower, Separate Vanity) Please Note: *LSVs and on-street parking are prohibited within Seaside. *(10) Seaside amenity wristbands and (2) parking passes are provided for guest use. Missing wristbands or parking passes are subject to a replacement fee of $150 plus tax per item. *Swim and Fitness passes are automatically included with the reservation. If you do not wish to use the community pools or fitness center, please contact our team immediately after booking regarding removal of this charge. Once removed, amenity access cannot be added back to the reservation. *Cookware larger than 9" x 13" will not fit inside the AGA range compartments. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
